mapper.insert: INSERT INTO form_field (section_id, subsection_id, field_key, label, description, type, options, dict_key, required, show_when, sort_order, config) VALUES (#{sectionId}, #{subsectionId}, #{fieldKey}, #{label}, #{description}, #{type}, #{options}, #{dictKey}, #{required}, #{showWhen}, #{sortOrder}, #{config})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM form_field WHERE dict_key = #{dictKey}
